limitations: The integer-only provider is a bounded comparison image; it intentionally omits binary16 semantics and reports NDIV unsupported.
Only integer NADD is executed through the integer-only linked payload. NSUB, NMUL, NCMP and NDIV are assembled but are not full workload proofs.
The payload retains the prepared 0x2A05 origin, so the fixed-origin complete initialized footprint has no claimed whole-image saving.
The included build relies on the existing prepared provider and its provider test; this experiment does not claim CP/M publication or compiler integration.
The host assembler, NOBJ encoder/parser, linker and Debug80 write observer are test oracles.
